segments.he: אָכַל חֵלֶב וָדָם פִּיגּוּל וְנוֹתָר – חַיָּיב כּוּ׳.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: If «one ate» forbidden «fat, and blood, and piggul, and notar» in one lapse of awareness, he is «liable» to bring a sin offering for each and every one of them. In a case where one ate half an olive-bulk and then ate another half olive-bulk during one lapse of awareness, if the two half olive-bulks were both from one type of forbidden food, he is liable to bring a sin offering. If they were from two types, he is exempt.

moves.about: one who ate fat, blood, piggul and notar is liable for each
